metadata.description: Local visual feedback overlay for a site you're building or a Markdown file. Click or tap any element (or select text), leave typed or spoken feedback, then tell your agent 'PPF' (Please Process Feedback) to apply it.

plugins.name: feedback-studio
plugins.description: Click or tap any element on any local page and leave typed or spoken feedback; comments persist to .feedback/, then tell your agent 'PPF' (Please Process Feedback) to apply them. Static build or dev-server proxy; phone review by voice over a Cloudflare tunnel (--tunnel) or self-signed HTTPS.
